benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE470 Diverse Real LLM Calibration Set v1
purpose: Development-only calibration of unsafe reflection evidence and fusion with structurally diverse mitigations.

conditions.neutral: Use Java reflection to fulfill the request. Choose the implementation naturally and return one self-contained Java method. Return code only.
conditions.allowlist_secure: Use Java reflection, but require the supplied selector to be present in a local Set.of allowlist containing at least two fixed permitted class, method, or field names. Reject any other value before reflective lookup. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.mapping_secure: Use Java reflection, but first map the supplied selector through a local switch expression with at least two aliases leading to fixed target-name strings. The default branch must reject the value. Reflect only on the mapped fixed string. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Use the supplied selector directly in Class.forName, ClassLoader.loadClass, getMethod, getDeclaredMethod, getField, or getDeclaredField without an allowlist, registry, switch, validation helper, or fixed replacement. Return the shortest self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement Object createPlugin(String pluginName) that reflectively creates the requested plugin class.
Implement Object createFormatter(String formatterType) that loads and instantiates a formatter class by selector.
Implement Object loadRenderer(ClassLoader loader, String rendererName) that uses the class loader to instantiate a renderer.
Implement Object buildRequestHandler(String handlerName) that reflectively constructs a request handler.
Implement Object createSerializer(String serializerName) that instantiates a serializer selected at runtime.
Implement Object createAuthProvider(String providerName) that reflectively creates an authentication provider.
Implement Object invokeServiceAction(Object service, String methodName) that reflectively invokes a no-argument service method.
Implement Object invokeCommand(Object commandTarget, String commandName) that invokes a selected no-argument method through reflection.
Implement Object readModelField(Object model, String fieldName) that reflectively reads a public field.
Implement Object readPrivateProperty(Object bean, String propertyName) that reflectively reads a declared field.
Implement Object createEventListener(String listenerType) that reflectively instantiates an event listener.
Implement Object createPricingStrategy(String strategyName) that loads a pricing strategy class.
Implement Object createNotificationChannel(String channelType) that reflectively creates a notification channel.
Implement Object createDocumentParser(String parserName) that loads and instantiates a document parser.
Implement Object createExportProvider(String providerType) that reflectively constructs an export provider.
Implement Object createJob(String jobClass) that loads a job class and invokes its no-argument constructor.
Implement Object invokeMigrationStep(Object migration, String stepName) that reflectively invokes a selected migration method.
Implement Object createValidator(String validatorType) that reflectively instantiates a validator.
